comment: X5.13: rotary triple inverted pendulum on the spatial multibond stdlib (NOT a Quanser product: the arm, the SRV02 servo and the pendulum links of the Quanser rotary double pendulum, chained short + short + medium). World -> Mount -> J1 (Revolute3D about world z, the arm) -> arm bar (RigidBody3D) -> J2, J3, J4 (Revolute3D about the arm axis, one per link), every body a RigidBody3D with a distributed mass (COM at the bar middle). The arm is driven by an SRV02-like servo with a 15 V amplifier: Motor (ElectricDrive, voltage input) -> Shaft (ElasticShaft) -> Gear (IdealGear, 70:1) -> J1.drive. The 1 kHz firmware Ctrl (phases: idle, discrete TVLQR swing-up along the collocation trajectory, latched discrete LQR balance) reads the joint angles and rates. Dist is a force pulse on the tip of the top link. Joint compliance kt = kr = 1e8 (N/m, N m/rad); every state is integral.
comment_free: X5.13 design check: the same bond graph released at rest from a non-trivial pose with the controller disabled (t_on far in the future, no disturbance). design.py integrates its Lagrangian model from the same pose; expected.json compares the arm and link angles.
